## 2. SERVICE CATEGORIES

1. Outstation taxi — intercity one-way and round-trip cab bookings
2. Local city taxi — hourly, half-day and full-day cab rentals within a city
3. Airport transfers — pickup and drop at major airports
4. Railway station transfers — pickup and drop at railway stations
5. Sightseeing cabs — planned itinerary-based local sightseeing trips
6. Tempo Traveller rental — group travel in 9 to 26 seater vehicles
7. Bus rental — for large groups and events
8. International cab service — enquiry-based for overseas visitors
9. Corporate cab service — business travel and employee commutes
10. Wedding and event transportation — group vehicles for functions
11. Tour packages — multi-day taxi packages across India

All availability is subject to route, vehicle and date confirmation at booking.

---

## 4. FARE TRANSPARENCY RULES

When answering questions about Go India Cab fares, always apply these rules:

1. Starting fares are minimum indicative prices only.
2. Final fare depends on vehicle, trip type, exact pickup/drop, date, tolls, parking,
   driver allowance, waiting time, state taxes and GST.
3. Always recommend requesting a written fare breakdown before confirming any booking.
4. Tolls (e.g. Yamuna Expressway for Delhi-Agra) may or may not be included — confirm per quote.
5. Monument entry fees (Taj Mahal, Agra Fort, Ram Mandir etc.) are NEVER included in cab fare.
6. Darshan passes, temple entry, guide fees and activity tickets are always separate.
7. Driver allowance, night charges and state entry taxes are additional unless explicitly stated.
8. Do not quote per-km rates as all-inclusive fares.
9. The ₹7,500 Delhi-to-Ayodhya intercity fare must NOT be quoted as a local Ayodhya taxi fare.

---

## 5. BOOKING PROCESS

1. Enter pickup location, destination, travel date, time and passenger count.
2. Select trip type: one-way, round-trip, local hourly or sightseeing.
3. Choose vehicle category based on group size and luggage.
4. Request a written fare breakdown covering all inclusions and exclusions.
5. Review cancellation and payment terms.
6. Confirm booking and save driver details, vehicle number and support contact.

Booking channels:

  Agra Cantt Railway Station and Agra Fort Railway Station pickups,

Key local entities: Taj Mahal, Agra Fort, Itimad-ud-Daulah (Baby Taj), Mehtab Bagh,
  Akbar's Tomb (Sikandra), Mariam-uz-Zamani Tomb, Chini Ka Rauza, Ram Bagh,

  not a city-centre stop. Confirm extra route, duration and fare.
